name: OpenSEO
tagline: Open-source SEO research, audits, and AI visibility
description: OpenSEO brings keyword research, rank tracking, competitor research, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility into one workspace. Self-host the MIT-licensed application and connect your own DataForSEO account, or use the hosted service. SEO data requests and hosted plans are billed separately.
useCases: Research keywords and competitor search performance
Track rankings and review site audits
Inspect AI visibility and connect SEO workflows to an AI agent

name: SEOnaut
tagline: Find and prioritize technical SEO issues
description: SEOnaut crawls websites and groups technical SEO issues by severity, including broken links, redirects, missing or duplicate metadata, and heading problems. Its web dashboard can run on your own server with Go, MySQL, and Docker; a hosted service is also available.
useCases: Audit a website for technical SEO problems
Prioritize broken links and metadata fixes
Review crawl results in a shared web dashboard

name: SerpBear
description: SerpBear tracks Google keyword positions for multiple domains and sends reports about ranking changes. It includes a reporting API and optional Google Ads integration for keyword research. The application is MIT-licensed; search scraping services, proxies, and hosting may incur separate costs.
useCases: Monitor keyword positions across domains
Receive ranking change reports
Export search ranking data to reporting workflows

name: SiteOne Crawler
tagline: Cross-platform website crawling and SEO audits
description: SiteOne Crawler scans websites for SEO, accessibility, security, and performance issues and exports reports in HTML, JSON, and text. It runs as a native command-line application with a companion desktop interface. Optional AI analysis can suggest metadata changes and generate llms.txt using your own model provider.
useCases: Audit technical SEO and website quality
Export crawl findings for clients or automation
Check site content and prepare llms.txt with optional AI assistance

name: LibreCrawl
tagline: Self-hosted SEO crawler with JavaScript rendering
description: LibreCrawl crawls websites, extracts titles, descriptions and headings, maps links, and detects SEO issues. Its web interface supports JavaScript rendering, PageSpeed Insights integration, and CSV, Excel, JSON, and XML exports. Run the MIT-licensed application locally or on your own infrastructure.
useCases: Crawl JavaScript-rendered websites
Inspect page metadata and internal links
Export SEO audit data for analysis

name: OneGlanse
tagline: Track brand visibility in AI search answers
description: OneGlanse runs selected prompts in supported AI products and records whether they mention, recommend, or cite your brand. It compares competitors and preserves captured answers for review. The MIT-licensed application runs locally or on your server and requires your own AI accounts and analysis-model key; provider and infrastructure costs are separate.
useCases: Measure brand mentions and citations in AI answers
Compare your AI search visibility with competitors
Inspect the captured answers behind visibility metrics

name: Mautic
description: Mautic is a self-hosted marketing automation platform for multichannel campaigns, audience segmentation, and automated customer journeys. Run the GPL-licensed application with your own database and integrations. Hosting, maintenance, and connected email or messaging providers have their own operating costs.
useCases: Build automated marketing campaigns
Segment audiences for targeted communication
Coordinate customer journeys across marketing channels

name: listmonk
description: listmonk is a standalone newsletter and mailing-list manager with a web dashboard, PostgreSQL storage, and a single-binary server. The AGPL-licensed application lets you manage subscribers and send campaigns on your own infrastructure. Email delivery and hosting costs depend on the providers you configure.
useCases: Manage newsletter subscribers and mailing lists
Send email campaigns from your own infrastructure
Operate a newsletter with a lightweight standalone server

name: Keila
description: Keila helps create newsletters, manage subscribers, and publish signup forms. Self-host the AGPL-licensed application or choose Keila Cloud. The self-hosted edition uses the email delivery service you configure; cloud plans and delivery providers are priced separately.
useCases: Create and send newsletter campaigns
Collect subscribers with signup forms
Run an email newsletter on your own server

name: SendPortal
tagline: Self-hosted email marketing and campaign reports
description: SendPortal manages subscribers, mailing lists, email campaigns, message tracking, and reporting across workspaces. The MIT-licensed application integrates with email providers including Amazon SES, Postmark, SendGrid, Mailgun, and Mailjet. Hosting and email delivery are separate operating costs.
useCases: Manage subscriber lists and email campaigns
Track email delivery and campaign reports
Operate separate email marketing workspaces

name: Postiz
tagline: Open-source social media scheduling and analytics
description: Postiz schedules and publishes social media content, supports team collaboration, and provides analytics and automation integrations. Deploy the AGPL-licensed edition yourself or use Postiz Cloud. Self-hosting requires your own infrastructure and social-platform app credentials; optional AI features use your own provider keys.
useCases: Plan and schedule social media posts
Collaborate on a shared content calendar
Connect publishing workflows to automation tools

name: Mixpost Lite
description: Mixpost Lite is the MIT-licensed community edition of Mixpost for managing and scheduling social media content on your own server. It helps organize content publishing from a web interface. Commercial Pro and Enterprise editions provide additional capabilities and are sold separately.
useCases: Organize a social media publishing workflow
Schedule content from a self-hosted interface
Evaluate the community edition before considering commercial upgrades
